title: Unauthenticated SQL Injection in product filter API
description: The category filter parameter in GET /api/products?cat= is interpolated directly into raw SQL string without prepared statement parameters: SELECT * FROM items WHERE cat = '\ + cat + \"' allowing full database dump."

title: Reflected XSS in search results page
description: Search query parameter q is echoed back into page template without HTML entity escaping. Payload <script>alert(1)</script> executes in the user's browser session.

title: Stripe payment webhook signature not validated
description: Incoming payment notifications from Stripe are accepted without verifying the Stripe-Signature header, permitting forged successful payment webhooks.

title: Password hash exposure in user export CSV
description: Administrator user export feature includes bcrypt password hashes in column E of the generated spreadsheet file.

title: Insecure Direct Object Reference in user profile API
description: Authenticated user can view and edit any other user's profile details by modifying the user_id path parameter in GET/PUT /api/users/{id}.

title: Memory leak in PDF export microservice
description: Generating large invoice PDFs allocates memory buffers that are never garbage collected, causing OOM restarts during peak hours.

title: Duplicate transaction generated when user double-clicks pay button
description: The pay button lacks client-side debouncing and the backend lacks idempotency keys, charging customers twice on rapid double-clicks.

title: Responsive navigation menu does not toggle on iOS Safari
description: Tapping the hamburger menu button on iOS Safari fails to open navigation drawer due to incompatible touch event handler.

title: Database connection timeout during heavy checkout load
description: Connection pool runs out of available connections during flash sale, causing 504 Gateway Timeout on checkout API.

title: Session cookie lacks HttpOnly and Secure flags
description: Session identifier cookies are created without HttpOnly and Secure attributes, leaving them vulnerable to theft via XSS attacks.

title: Broken discount voucher calculation logic
description: Entering coupon code SUMMER20 subtracts 200 dollars instead of 20 percent from cart total, allowing free orders.

title: Dark theme typography has insufficient contrast
description: Secondary text in the analytics table uses dark gray text (#555) on dark background (#222), failing WCAG AA contrast standards.

title: Arbitrary file read via path traversal in avatar endpoint
description: User profile image endpoint allows downloading system files using parameter path=../../../../etc/shadow.

title: HTTP 500 error when uploading zero-byte profile picture
description: Uploading an empty 0-byte image file throws unhandled EmptyFileException instead of returning a friendly 400 Bad Request error.

title: Off-by-one error in monthly revenue graph
description: The last day of the month is omitted from monthly analytics charts because date range loop uses < instead of <= comparison.

title: Missing rate limiting on password reset endpoint
description: Users can trigger thousands of password reset emails per minute, leading to email service quota exhaustion and spam abuse.

title: TCP socket timeout when contacting notification SMS gateway
description: Intermittent packet drops to external SMS gateway cause user OTP verification requests to hang for 60 seconds.

title: Unsanitized input in shell execution utility
description: Administrative server diagnostics page passes command parameter directly to subprocess.Popen(cmd, shell=True), enabling remote shell execution.

title: Missing translation for Japanese currency symbol
description: JPY prices are rendered with USD dollar sign '$' instead of Yen symbol '¥' on checkout confirmation screen.

title: Slow query on user activity audit log table
description: Querying recent audit events performs full table scan on 5M rows due to missing composite index on (user_id, timestamp).

title: Session not invalidated on password change
description: Changing account password does not revoke existing active session tokens on other devices or browsers.

title: Tooltip popup trapped behind modal window
description: Help tooltip has z-index 100 while modal overlay has z-index 1050, hiding helpful contextual instructions.

title: CORS wildcard policy on sensitive banking API
description: The header Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * is returned on all payment endpoints, allowing cross-origin data exfiltration.

title: Broken phone number validation regex rejects valid UK numbers
description: Regular expression for phone verification fails for UK mobile numbers containing spaces or international +44 prefix.

title: Database deadlock during concurrent wallet transfers
description: Transferring balance between two users simultaneously causes deadlock in PostgreSQL transaction manager.
